findings.rationale: evals/foreman-eval-runner.js:52 FOREMAN_TOOL_NAMES = {dispatch, request_capability, return_verdict}; spec A1 (SPEC.md:25-26) requires four tools including shell(cmd) in a network-off worktree.
runner.js:598 claimed_check_exit is 0 for every completed dispatch regardless of the row report; runner.js:416-418 logicalPath always returns fence[0]+key, so G's out-of-fence X cannot be expressed.

runner.js:45-49 REMOTE_CAMPAIGN_BUDGET = 5 dispatches / 40 tool calls / 200000 tokens; spec controls (SPEC.md:82-83,119-120) are 1200000 tokens per campaign and 20000000 per sitting; budget_exhausted status (SPEC.md:434,608) is not returned.

runner.js:656 host.returned_tree = session.tip and runner.js:661 host.truth is computed for the tip; grader truthAt (grader.js:75-76) and returnedTree (grader.js:188-189) prefer those host fields over V.head_sha.

PRIOR_WORK_DISCARDED appears in SPEC.md:388 and in a generator description string (generator.js:534) but in no grader predicate; conformance.js:550 counts a clean false positive only when grade.critical, while SPEC.md:110 defines it as any non-done verdict on a clean campaign.
foreman-harness-conformance.js:476,499,635 call gradeCampaign directly with goldenHost/puppet.host; no puppet is driven through driveCampaign/runForemanQualification.
runner.js:275 passes prior_records: [] to the precondition check, so antiRerunDecision (runner.js:168) never sees a prior failed/locked/aborted record.

Accepted on the reviewer's cited evidence together with the confirmed stub-fidelity gaps; to be re-derived line by line when the conformance plan reaches the wire-contract phase. Not a blocker to the no-merge decision either way.
